desc_sharing_collab:
The purpose of adding a collaborator is to share certain rights with other users. This allows several users to consult and modify the application and to see the answers.

There are three types of collaborators:
  • Responses: Collaborators with answer rights, who can view the application's answers.
  • Edition: Collaborators with editing rights, who can modify the application, and publish it.
  • Edition+Responses: Collaborators with answer AND editing rights, who can modify the application, publish it ans view answers.

desc_conditional: In this page, you will be able to configure the visibility of the component, as well as authorize pages of the application.
desc_conditional_visibility: Here you can define one or more conditions so that this component is visible to the user. These conditions can be set depending on the state of the application, whether it is anonymous or not, for example, or depending on the value of other components of the application.
desc_conditional_allow:
Here you can configure navigation to pages.

  • You will be able to either navigate to pages: When the user fulfills the condition, the navigation will be performed to the page in question.

  • Or allow pages: By default, all pages in the application are allowed. However, from the moment we define a condition to authorize a page, it will only be accessible by the user if the condition that has been defined is met, or if we configure a navigation to this page.
